prompt: As of January 1st, 2024, how many buildings in New York City were 750ft or taller the last time Halley's Comet came close to Earth?
answer:
As of January 1, 2024, **14 New York City buildings were at least 750 feet tall in 1986**, the year of Halley’s Comet’s most recent close approach to Earth.

They included the Twin World Trade Center towers, the Empire State Building, Chrysler Building, 70 Pine Street, American International Building, 40 Wall Street, Citicorp Center, 30 Rockefeller Plaza, MetLife Building, Woolworth Building, One Chase Manhattan Plaza, One Penn Plaza, and 1251 Avenue of the Americas.

*This counts buildings that existed in 1986, including the World Trade Center towers, even though they no longer stood in 2024.*
